Four synthetic, locally authored scores isolate M4 episode/duration/cadence gates. The encoder and fixed expectation manifest precede producer execution. Independent voices intentionally contain three existing parallel-fifth transitions; they do not veto compatibility. The chordal variant has no independently evaluable melodic pairs. Exact 3/5 equality and a 1/4 extension of sparse unavailable material isolate the duration gate. Further controls use approved M3 sources or temporary source variants in tests; no corpus material.
